svg.text: A diagram, not the screen. Lit as a new player who follows the glow has it at about level 6; the glowing lamp is the next suggestion.
The Warden's Oath: the dash is Bull Rush
greatsword: heavy blows, stagger, holy fire
sword and shield: block, Ward, retaliation
the Shambles, on to the Butcher
the Duelist's Road, on to the Skirmisher
blue lamp: a rule with a price
reflex: an art that fires itself
